api.NETWORK_ERROR: Server is unreachable. Start the backend and try again.
api.UNEXPECTED_ERROR: The server returned an unexpected response.
api.COMFY_ERROR: ComfyUI encountered an error. Check its console.
api.COMFY_LORA_LIST_ERROR: Could not load the ComfyUI LoRA list. Try again.
api.COMFY_LORA_LIST_INVALID: ComfyUI returned an unreadable LoRA list.
api.COMFY_OBJECT_INFO_ERROR: Could not load ComfyUI sampler options. Try again.
api.COMFY_OUTPUT_MISSING: ComfyUI finished without producing an image.
api.COMFY_UNAVAILABLE: ComfyUI is not running. Start it, then retry.
api.IMAGE_STORE_FAILED: Could not store the image. Check the server console.
api.IMAGE_UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: Reference image must be a PNG or JPEG.
api.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR: The server hit an unexpected error. Check its console.
api.INVALID_IMAGE_CURSOR: The image list is out of sync. Reload to continue.
api.INVALID_TASK_CURSOR: The task list is out of sync. Reload to continue.
api.ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED: This origin is not allowed to connect to the server.
api.SERVER_STOPPING: The server is shutting down. Try again after it restarts.
api.TASK_ACTIVE: One or more tasks are still active.
api.TASK_GENERATE_ERROR: Generation failed. Check the ComfyUI console for details.
api.VALIDATION_ERROR: The server rejected the request as invalid.
api.WORKFLOW_ARCHIVED: This workflow is archived and cannot be used.
api.WORKFLOW_MAPPING_INVALID: Some workflow bindings do not resolve against this graph.
api.WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND: That workflow is gone. The list has been refreshed — pick one and try again.
api.WORKFLOW_REVISION_CONFLICT: This workflow changed elsewhere. Reload it before saving again.
